- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly 2D RPG in an old RPG Maker-inspired pixel-art style, starting with a green pixel field.

- User requested an Old RPGM-style 2D RPG for mobile phones, beginning with a green pixel field.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

- Created a self-contained browser game with hand-drawn canvas pixel art and no game framework.
- Chose a meadow quest: meet Mira, gather three moonpetals, and return to her.

- Added responsive game UI, mobile touch controls, keyboard controls, NPC dialogue, collectible quest progress, sound toggle, and pixel-art meadow/player/NPC rendering.

- Saved and inspected mobile viewport screenshot at `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

- `index.html`: Game shell, quest UI, mobile controls, dialogue overlay.

- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, movement, interactions, and quest logic.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Latest inspected mobile viewport screenshot.
